title: Works great
date: Reviewed in the United States on May 18, 2026
review: These come in the box just as you see them there’s no rapper any containers on them. There’s a little tab at the top so you can just put a thumbtack on the wall wherever you want them but they have accumulated a lot of little gnats and fruit flies in a very short time I’ll include pictures. I’m very happy with these. I’m gonna order another box in case I need them.

title: Work great, a little sticky to handle
date: Reviewed in the United States on May 14, 2026
review: The traps work really well. They are a bit sticky to handle (wear gloves), but they really catch flies and other flying insects. I hung two out in my back yard and within a week they were already full of flies, gnats and mosquitos. Definitely worth the money for me and I would recommend them.

review: These traps have helped me with my drain fruit fly problems. They don't get to the root of the problem but sure catches a lot of the little buggers. They are a helpful tool. warning don't touch them.

title: Got gnats? Here's one answer.
date: Reviewed in the United States on May 19, 2024
review: It is extremely sticky, natch, but at that inflated price I was expecting it to emit a fragrance (no, not rotting fruit)  that attracts the tiny insects that have become the bane of my existence. No, it just sits there, exactly like the silver ones from Black Flag. I actually think the Black Flag strips are stickier because our poofy cat (busy body) had to leap up on the counter to inspect it, only a tiny bit of hair stuck. When she did the same (I know) to the BF one, I thought she would need skin grafts! Tip: use natural paint stripper to get fly paper glue out of pet fur! Anyway, not really worth the extra money.

title: Disappointed and mad...
date: Reviewed in the United States on May 28, 2026
review: Save your money. Doesn't have a cover around the sticky part, what a mess! The tiny hook is totally useless . I threw the whole package away. I had that sticky stuff on my hands and it is hard to wash off. It was a total waste of my money!!!

title: Works great. Easy to hang
date: Reviewed in the United States on April 23, 2026
review: These worked surprisingly well! I used them both indoors and outside on the patio, and they started catching gnats,no seeums and other flying insects quickly. Easy to hang, no mess, and disposable so cleanup is simple. Great value for the 4-pack and helpful during warmer months.
